def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 3:
                candidates = [grid[h - 1 - r][c], grid[r][w - 1 - c], grid[h - 1 - r][w - 1 - c]]
                out[r][c] = next((v for v in candidates if v != 3), grid[r][c])
    return out
